# #1799: Patch: the web's tests take their stub-server, sign-in and fake audio helpers from one place instead of dozens of private copies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Many of the web client's test files start by writing the same small helpers again:
- a fake server reply;
- a "this must exist" check;
- signing a test player in;
- moving the page to an address;
- a fake sound engine with some twenty stubbed methods.

Some of these already live in shared test modules and are copied anyway; others exist only as copies. Once built, the tests import them from one place. That means fewer lines, and a change to the sound engine or the account reply is made once and caught by the type checker, instead of slipping past a stale copy.

## Why
Counts under `apps/web/src`, test files only:
- `must` is exported at `test/stubServer.ts:95`, yet 16 test files define their own.
- `jsonResponse` is exported at `test/stubServer.ts:31`, yet 7 files define their own. Some of those are cut-down fakes with no `json()` or headers.
- `at(path)` (`window.history.replaceState(null, "", path)`) has 19 copies, and `signedIn()` (one `localStorage.setItem` of the e2e session key) has 16. Neither is shared.
- A fake `AudioEngine` takes 130 `vi.fn<AudioEngine[…]>` lines across 8 test files.
  - The 20-line `fakeEngine()` is the same in `packs/PackOpening.test.tsx`, `emotes/PortraitPicker.test.tsx`, `economy/XpReveal.test.tsx` and `economy/OpeningBars.test.tsx`.
  - Meanwhile `audio/test/fakeAudio.ts` already holds the shared audio fakes (`fakeContextFactory`, `fakeSpeech`).
- The `meBody()` copies (for example in `routes/gate.test.tsx` and `net/gate-refresh.test.tsx`) are untyped, so a change to `MeResponse` (`net/api.ts`) doesn't fail them.

## Proposal
- Import `must` and `jsonResponse` from `test/stubServer.ts` everywhere. Add `at(path)`, `signIn(token?)` and a typed `meBody(over?: Partial<MeResponse>): MeResponse` beside them.
- Add `fakeAudioEngine(overrides?)` to `audio/test/fakeAudio.ts`, typed as a mapped type over `AudioEngine` so a new method fails typecheck in one place. Use it in the 8 files.
- No test's assertions or names change. Where a file's cut-down `jsonResponse` behaved differently from the shared one, review that test by hand before swapping it.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/test/stubServer.ts`, `apps/web/src/audio/test/fakeAudio.ts`
- About 45 `*.test.ts(x)` files under `apps/web/src`
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh` already maps `apps/web/src/test/`, so it needs no change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` runs the same number of tests before and after, all passing.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.
- [ ] No test file under `apps/web/src` defines its own `must`, `jsonResponse`, `at`, `signedIn` or `fakeEngine`.
- [ ] `meBody` and `fakeAudioEngine` are typed against `MeResponse` and `AudioEngine`.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 45 files and roughly 300 lines removed, all test-only. The main risk is a test that relied on a cut-down fake. Swapping in the full one could change what that test exercises, hence the by-hand review. Touching `apps/web/src/test/` widens the pull request's CI scope.
